Phones in my office have been ringing off the hook.

-Mothers wonder if they will be able to feed their children.
-Cancer patients ask if their chemotherapy will be paid for.
-Families are scared they won’t be able to pay rent.

This is the reality of the Trump funding freeze.

The Republican budget plan is devastating. In #MI13 alone, it: 

1. Cuts healthcare for 333,000
2. Slashes food assistance for 225,000
3. Doubles Medicare premiums for seniors 

All to pay for more tax cuts for president Musk and his billionaire buddies.

Medicaid protects lives—and in MI-13, 333,421 people are in danger of losing coverage because of Trump, DOGE, and Republicans in Congress.

I won’t stop fighting to protect our community’s health and make care more affordable for all.

I was proud to meet with Animal Wellness Action yesterday to discuss animal welfare and how we can best support our furry friends in Washington.

I am keeping him and his family in my thoughts and wishing them strength.
